column1: #mapping_set_title: COPI-FLOC to ODP-FL v0.8 term correspondence
#comment: Term-by-term correspondence between the FOIS 2026 functional-location
#  design pattern (ODP-FL v0.8) and the COPI module migrated from it, so the
#  published pattern IRIs keep resolving to their COPI counterparts. exactMatch
#  means the reading is unchanged; closeMatch flags a re-parenting or a changed
#  domain, spelled out per row. Terms of v0.8 with NO counterpart are deliberately
#  absent from the module: fl:Equipment, fl:Sensor, fl:Valve,
#  fl:PressureSensingFunction (equipment and function classes, which belong to
#  the expected item class on the position, copi:COPI_0009033).
